string.name: privacy_content
string.value:
Thank you for using Momentum!

1. Account information: We collect your HUAWEI ID virtual identifiers (OpenID, UnionID), nickname and avatar, solely for sign-in, identity display and data ownership.
2. Goals & tasks: Data is stored on your device by default. After sign-in, cloud sync is enabled automatically to support multi-device sync (you can turn it off anytime in Settings); data is uploaded to HUAWEI Cloud and visible only to you.
3. Push & Live View: While a pomodoro is running, a system Live View shows the current phase, remaining time and the task name on your lock screen and status bar via the HUAWEI Push service; the app obtains a Push Token (a device-and-app-level identifier).
4. Feedback & reports: The feedback/report content you submit, contact info (optional), your HUAWEI ID identifier and diagnostic data (app version, device model, OS version, data-scale statistics; no actual content) are uploaded to the cloud solely for issue locating and product improvement, and are never shown to other users.
5. AI services: AI goal breakdown, review and todo suggestions are provided by the registered third-party large model (DeepSeek). We send the content you input plus statistical data of your goals/tasks (progress, status, priority, estimated time; tasks are anonymized as ordinal numbers, without names) to generate suggestions. See Article 3 of the User Agreement.
6. We will never sell or share your information with unrelated third parties. You can delete all data anytime in Settings, or contact us via the User Agreement.

If you have questions, contact the developer (see the User Agreement for contact info).

string.name: user_agreement_content
string.value:
Welcome to Qishi (起势, the App). This Agreement is between you and the developer (Sun Shengju, the Developer). By using the App you accept this Agreement.

1. Services: AI goal breakdown, roadmap management, Eisenhower task matrix, Pomodoro timer, statistics, home-screen widget and optional cloud sync.

2. Account: The App supports HUAWEI ID sign-in only. You may also use all local features as a guest. AI breakdown, cloud sync and feedback require sign-in. You are responsible for activities under your HUAWEI ID.

3. AI-generated content: The AI breakdown calls a registered third-party large model (DeepSeek, provided by Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd.; algorithm: DeepSeekChat求索对话生成算法, filing no. 网信算备330105747635301240017号). All AI output is explicitly labelled (AI-generated, for reference only) with a report entry. AI output is for reference only and does not constitute professional advice (medical, legal, financial or otherwise); you are responsible for decisions based on it. Do not use the AI feature to generate or spread content that violates laws or public morals.

4. Code of conduct: comply with applicable laws; no infringement, reverse engineering, attacks or service disruption.

5. Data & privacy: see the Privacy Policy. Goals and tasks are stored locally by default and uploaded only after you sign in and enable cloud sync. You can view, export, correct or delete your data anytime.

6. IP: The design, code, icons and copy of the App belong to the Developer. Content you enter belongs to you; AI output is for your personal in-app use.

7. Disclaimers: The App is provided as-is. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Developer makes no warranties. The Developer is not liable for failures caused by force majeure, network faults or third-party services, and total liability is limited to amounts you actually paid (the App is currently free).

8. Changes and termination: services may change, be interrupted or terminated with reasonable notice. You may stop using the App and delete your data anytime.

9. Minors: should use the App under guardian supervision.

10. Amendments: revised terms take effect upon publication; continued use constitutes acceptance.

11. Governing law: PRC law; disputes shall be resolved by friendly negotiation, failing which by a competent court at the Developer’s domicile.

12. Contact: Developer Sun Shengju | developersunshengju@163.com (reply within 15 business days).
